name: Pterios
source:
Son of [url=/c105726]Meliagris[/url] and [url=/c105725]Fregerilla[/url]. He is highly affected by the conflict between his secretive father and the jealousy and love of his mother. As a result someday he became frigid and keeps his heart closed to anyone new. Pterios gets involved in the main story only after his sister [url=/c105728]Corelle[/url] becomes interested in Mina.

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20040816084928/http://active-soft.jp/catalog/lostmind.html]official website[/url].]
